description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Extraction Specialist.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Extraction Specialist, adding {C}{C}.
When Extraction Specialist dies, Saffi triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
